thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 2026-03-15 14:22 UTC - Service: routing-proxy - Error spike (500s) observed for /v1/embeddings requests from us-west-2. Rate: 1200rps -> 15% 5xx
oncall-maria: paging oncall (maria) now, logs look bad for embedding route, docs customers calling in
jordan: I'm on it, just saw the deploy from earlier that touched alias mapping for model aliases->variants
sami: can you paste the deploy hash?
jordan: deploy: gh:refs/heads/main@c9f4b2 - I changed alias mapping to prefer latest pinned variant for alias 'redwood-embed' (shouldn't have changed alias strategy but did)
alex: symptoms: customers seeing 500 with body: 
```
{"error":"Model variant mismatch: requested endpoint embeddings but routed to chat-variant (incompatible I/O)"}
```
lia: ugh, that explains the stack traces showing chat.decoder.* being invoked from embed path
oncall-maria: @jordan are you able to rollback? If not i'll promote a mitigation
jordan: rolling back the alias change now: /deploy rollback c9f4b2 -> initiating
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: routing-fallback -> Step 1: Quarantine alias, Step 2: Remove pinned variant, Step 3: Verify traffic. Link: https://runbooks.internal/routing-fallback
oncall-maria: doing a quick quarantine: setting alias 'redwood-embed' -> quarantine mode (force only compatible variants)
alex: quick check: metrics - embeddings 5xx spiked at 14:21:43 UTC, error signature = VariantIncompatibleError; downstream client error count also spiked
sami: replayed a failing request in staging: same 500 when alias resolves to chat-xlarge-v1. Example request: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model_alias": "redwood-embed", "input":"hello" }
```
response: 500 VariantIncompatibleError

jordan: rollback finished (c9f4b2 reverted) at 14:24:10 UTC
lia: traffic still sees errors, maybe fallback caching persisted original mapping in edge cache for a few minutes
oncall-maria: flushing alias cache on router nodes now: `for node in $(nodes); do curl -X POST http://$node/internal/alias/flush; done`
alex: note: there is a routing fallback policy that allows alias->fallback to any compatible variant. Looks like the policy didn't check 'interface' capability (embed vs chat) so it allowed chat variant as fallback for embed requests
sami: found the policy config that was used by the router: 
```
fallback_policy:
  - prefer: cheapest
  - fallback_to: any_compatible_variant
```
We need to require interface compatibility: `compatible_interfaces: ["embeddings"]`
ops-runbook-bot: Suggestion: apply policy patch, and remove stale alias cache.
oncall-maria: who can patch the policy? @alex?
alex: i can ship a hotfix to the routing-config service to enforce interface compatibility in fallback checks. Will open PR and promote to canary in us-west-2 only.
jordan: also discovered the alias update was caused by an automated migration job that had a wrong default policy - I'm disabling the migration temporarily
oncall-maria: customers impacted: at least 3 enterprise customers reported failed embeddings, CS is on the line. @customer-success-bryan please notify customers and add timeline
customer-success-bryan: on it. Notifying affected customers with status: investigating -> mitigation in progress.
lia: alex - can you add a guard in router that rejects alias assignments where pinned variant interface != alias intended interface? That would have stopped this earlier
alex: yes plan: (1) patch fallback check to require variant.capabilities contains request.interface (2) add validation in alias-assignment API (3) add test coverage in integration tests. I'll deploy (1) as hotfix to router in 5m, then apply (2) in the next release
ops-runbook-bot: Hotfix checklist: create canary, monitor 5xx, validate embedding success rate > 99% over 5m, then promote.
alex: canary deployed to 2 nodes us-west-2 at 14:30:12 UTC. Monitoring metrics: embeddings 5xx dropping.
(14:31) alex: embeddings 5xx down to 1.9% from 15%.
(14:33) liaison note: cache TTL expired, rollback effective globally at 14:32:50 UTC
jordan: found the migration job config: `migrations/alias_update.yml` had `default_fallback: cheapest` without interface constraints. I'm patching and disabling automatic runs until validation is added.
oncall-maria: okay team, key mitigation steps: rollback alias change, flush caches, hotfix fallback check, disable migration, CS notifications. Any outstanding customer impact?
customer-success-bryan: customers see embed requests success rate recovering; we'll follow up with incident notice and offer logs + credits if SLA impacted
sami: postmortem action items: add compatibility checks to router, add migration validation, add monitoring alert for VariantIncompatibleError spike, create QA test to simulate alias fallbacks crossing interface types
lia: also add an automated preflight for alias changes that simulates a small percentage of traffic before flipping globally
jordan: i'll own migration validation and preflight work. ETA 2 days for validation tests, 1 week for preflight rollout
alex: i'll own router validation + hotfix follow-up. ETA patch to alias-assignment API 3 days, integration tests 5 days
oncall-maria: summary for pager: incident declared SEV2 at 14:22, mitigated at 14:32, oncall-sla: responded and paged. No data exfiltration, only availability impact for embedding endpoint.
ops-runbook-bot: Create incident ticket? https://incidents.internal/create -> ID INC-2026-214
customer-success-bryan: I'll draft customer-facing summary and include timeline and mitigation steps.
lia: any remaining checks? Let's keep monitoring for 30m then rotate to normal ops
(14:56) alex: embedding success rate stable at 99.98%, closing rotation in 4m.
oncall-maria: thanks everyone :pray: please add your names to the incident ticket for follow-ups
jordan: adding notes and revert details to ticket.
sami: creating postmortem doc draft now, will link to ticket.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 created and assigned to incidents@redwood. Postmortem draft link: https://pm.internal/inc-2026-214
customer-success-bryan: sending customer updates now.
lia: resolved. :white_check_mark:
